report.description: Google Ads API allows developers to programmatically manage Google Ads accounts, retrieve reports, and perform ad operations. It uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication and offers both REST and gRPC interfaces.

evidence.claim: Google Ads API requires OAuth 2.0 for authentication.
OAuth 2.0 flow uses client_id and client_secret for user authorization.
Google Ads API can be accessed via Service Account flow for Google Workspace.
Google Ads API provides broad coverage of campaign types including Performance Max, Demand Gen, Search, and Shopping.
Google Ads API offers both REST and gRPC interfaces.
